How it drives

Every base attribute is balanced. It is a clear way to feel what changing one setup does before learning a more specialised car.

Original perk

SHIFT moves 2 points between attributes instead of 1.

legendary Stays with this car.

Try a build

DOUBLE SHIFT later makes the two setups more distinct. CLEAN EXIT can support the transition out of a slide.

Practice: CLIFFSIDE. Explore CLEAN EXIT.

Example SHIFT setup

With DOUBLE SHIFT unlocked, one legal example moves two points per attribute. Lower TOP SPEED, ACCELERATION, CONTROL; raise DRIFT, BOOST POWER, BOOST TANK. Try the two states on the same section to feel the trade-off.

Set up SHIFT in GARAGE after 1,000 trophies · Shift. DOUBLE SHIFT has its own later unlock.
